method: Current MoonBit implementation in fresh processes, sequential scenarios; summary is median of process medians. Min/max span process medians, not individual operations.

samples.scope: Public Scene timeline segments and duration. Media cases have one video per ten objects visible only in the final Composition, plus an independent audio track. Sources are room references. Reads are repeated against a stable ordinary caller-owned Scene, without a cache. No frame evaluation, Yjs, UI, browser, media decoding or I/O.
samples.iterations: Two warmup + seven measured batches of 1000 calls in each fresh process
